mapper.insert: insert into theme_broadcast_delivery(session_id,member_id,event_id,content,status,attempts,create_time) values(#{sessionId},#{memberId},#{eventId},#{content},'PENDING',0,now()) on duplicate key update id=id
mapper.select: select id,event_id as eventId,content from theme_broadcast_delivery where session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and attempts<5 order by id limit 20 for update
mapper.update: update theme_broadcast_delivery set status='REACHED',message_id=#{messageId},attempts=attempts+1,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED')
update theme_broadcast_delivery set status='FAILED',attempts=attempts+1,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED')
mapper.select: select event_id as eventId,status,message_id as messageId,attempts from theme_broadcast_delivery where session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} order by id
